messages:
Evan (AE): Quick kickoff — Polestar POC. Need tight success criteria + eval harness design. Who can sketch the minimal acceptance checklist?
Priya (Solutions Eng): I can. Quick must-haves: 1) golden prompts set (500-1k), 2) scoring rubric (semantic similarity + factuality), 3) latency/throughput SLOs, 4) regression gates vs baseline, 5) security answers for risk review.
Luca (SE): For the harness: CSV with columns: id,input,expected,category. Autoscore using embedding cosine + optional token-overlap. Flag examples where similarity < 0.85 for human review.
Luca (SE): Recommended regression gate: new model must not drop >2% absolute on golden accuracy and no new false-positive hallucination rate >1%.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Use-case specifics from the AE: ~70% short Q&A, 30% long-form summarization. Latency goal p95 < 250ms for Q&A, throughput target 15 qps sustained for demo traffic. Cost cap for pilot: ~$2k/month (customer constraint).
Taylor (Security): Polestar asked about data residency & key management. We'll need: SOC2 report, KMS support, and confirmation that logs can be redacted/rotated. Private deployment option if they require on-prem.
Evan (AE): Pricing Q: Is there a standard pilot discount for 3-month reserved capacity?
FinanceBot: Pilot template: up to 3 months, 20% trial credit on usage, any committed reserved capacity priced with standard Dedicated tiers. I'll DM the contract snippet.
Luca (SE): Practical: baseline run command for harness we use:```
python eval/harness.py --model redwood-12b --gold-file polestar_golden.csv --threshold 0.85 --out results.json
```
Priya (Solutions Eng): Scoring details: 1) semantic score (cosine) >= 0.85, 2) factuality check via QA overlap heuristics >= 0.8, 3) regex checks for PII redaction. Final pass: sample 100 fails for manual labeling.
Luca (SE): For automation, add a nightly job that runs the golden set against the serving candidate and emits a regression report + diff heatmap. Canary route should point to fallback smaller quantized model on failures.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Timeline proposal: Week 0 (this week) — finalize golden prompts + security checklist, Week 1 — implement harness + baseline run, Week 2 — customer validation + manual labeling, Week 3 — iterate + sign-off. Total ~3–4 weeks.
Evan (AE): Owners: Priya = harness & customer orchestration, Luca = scoring infra & automation, Taylor = security questionnaires. I'll own pilot commercial terms. :thumbsup:
Taylor (Security): I'll open the security questionnaire and start filling SOC2/KMS answers. Expect initial draft by EOD tomorrow.
Evan (AE): Any blockers from infra or quotas? If Dedicated needed for throughput, flag now.
Luca (SE): One potential infra callout: for p95 <250ms at 15 qps we should reserve at least 1 dedicated pod (A100-equivalent) during demo windows.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a condensed acceptance checklist for the customer that maps each gate to pass/fail actions. Will post draft by tomorrow.
Evan (AE): Perfect — let's reconvene after Priya's draft. Thanks all.
